items.title: 8.11.1 Le Chatelier ke usool ke istemalat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.11.1, printed page 179.

blocks.text: Tabee aur kimiyai equilibria par is usool ke sab se aam istemalat concentration ki tabdeeli ka asar, dabao ki tabdeeli ka asar, darja hararat ki tabdeeli ka asar, aur equilibrium par catalyst ka asar hain; har ek topics 8.12 se 8.15 mein bayan hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar dabbe: bismuth chloride hydrolysis mein concentration ki tabdeeliyan; ammonia synthesis mein dabao ki tabdeeliyan; exothermic SO3 aur endothermic NO2 equilibria mein darja hararat ki tabdeeliyan un ki Kc qeematon ke saath; aur ek chhota energy diagram jis mein ek hi reactant aur product sathon ke darmiyan surkh uncatalysed aur sabz catalysed ubhar hai. Neeche khulasa dabba equilibrium ki position ko equilibrium constant se alag karta hai.
blocks.caption: Concentration, dabao, darja hararat aur catalyst par Le Chatelier ka usool (topics 8.12 se 8.15 aur Figure 8.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Reactant shamil karna ya product hatana equilibrium ko daen dhakelta hai; product shamil karna ya reactant hatana baen. Dabao barhana kam gas molecules wali taraf ko tarjeeh deta hai. Darja hararat barhana endothermic simt ko tarjeeh deta hai, to garam karna exothermic SO3 banne ka Kc ghatata aur endothermic N2O4 tootne ka barhata hai. Catalyst dono activation rukawatein barabar ghata kar wahi equilibrium jaldi pata hai. Sirf darja hararat khud Kc badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa akela aamil equilibrium constant ki qeemat badalta hai, aur baqi awamil kya badalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Sirf darja hararat Kc badalta hai. Concentration, dabao ya hajm ki tabdeeliyan equilibrium ki position, mixture ke tanasub, badalti hain jabke Kc wahi rehta hai; catalyst na position badalta hai na Kc, sirf equilibrium tak pohnchne ki raftar.

items: Chaar istemalat: concentration (8.12), dabao ya hajm (8.13), darja hararat (8.14), catalyst (8.15); sirf darja hararat Kc badalta hai.
